source_name: 搜韵典故索引（用户提供的本地抓取结果）
integration: The user supplied a scraped directory outside the project. Only the self-contained allusions JSONL needed at runtime was copied into data/allusions; cache pages, crawler code, SQLite/CSV/HTML derivatives and logs were intentionally excluded. The external development path is not retained.
limitations: This is a partial snapshot: the source site describes a larger collection, so a local miss does not mean that an allusion does not exist.
The supplied export contains no parsed poetic examples even though the crawler workspace may retain examples in cached HTML.
The supplied README says the data is for personal research use and does not provide a redistribution license.
Glosses are absent for many records; source passages and aliases remain source evidence but still require contextual interpretation.
The project does not depend on the original crawler directory or perform network requests when querying this data.
